summary: Frontend-only test of the Pulse brand colour pass. I checked /, /pricing, /login, /master-admin, /dashboard, /service-desk (Dashboard, Cases and Scheduler tabs), /crm, /staff-portal, the Lite dashboard /pulse (lite.suptest@pulsedemo.test) and /bfpo (MOD, lee.somers@pulsefitness.com / TempPass123!), at 1920x800 and 390x844, in light and dark mode. Method: a computed-style audit (/app/tests/colour_audit.js) that finds the real background behind each text element, works out the WCAG contrast ratio and flags off-brand hues, plus screenshots to confirm. Most surfaces are on-brand: /login, /pricing, /dashboard, /crm, /staff-portal, /bfpo (light), and /pulse in both themes. In dark mode the body is Soft Black #1B1C1D. FAILURES: (1) The 'Team Performance' dark card on /service-desk has invisible stat numbers in light mode. (2) In dark mode the /service-desk stat cards show dark text on dark cards. (3) In dark mode the /bfpo panel headings are white on white. Off-brand colours remain: an indigo #5B5BF5 KPI icon, an iOS-blue #007AFF CRM '+' button, an amber/orange/rose decorative gradient on the Pulse Pro upgrade card, and a navy-tinted #14181F landing gradient. Core Blue #19CDFF is widely used as text on white (about 1.6-1.9:1 contrast).

ui_bugs.component: Service Desk > Team Performance hero (LIGHT mode, desktop + mobile)
ui_bugs.issue: The MiniStat values (0 / 0h / 0) and the FTF ring '0%' are #1B1C1D on #26292B (1.17:1), so they are effectively invisible. RCA: the Card's dark background is an inline-style linear-gradient (DeskPerformance.js ~L110). The index.css L782 rule '[data-theme=light] .text-white {color: var(--theme-text)}' flips them to dark, and the preserve-white list (L786-813) has no entry for this card. Fix: add className 'on-dark' to the hero Card (the existing helper at index.css ~L821).

The stat cards show dark text on dark cards (#1B1C1D on #26292B, 1.17:1): 558/554/0/4, 'Recent Activity', and the desk-perf-* tile numbers and labels. The sidebar role badge 'Master Admin' is white on white. RCA: the page wrapper is 'theme-gymaxis' with data-theme="light", so the dark: variants are cancelled. But shadcn bg-card reads --card, which is set only on html[data-theme=dark] (index.css L1539), and the nested light subtree never resets it. Fix: change index.css L1512 ':root {' to ':root, [data-theme="light"] {'.

The 'Needs attention now' and 'Sites requiring attention' h2 headings are white on white (1:1). The panels are hard-coded bg-white while the dark override turns text-slate-900 white. The KPI cards also stay white on the Soft Black page, which looks inconsistent. File: pages/BFPO/staff/StaffDashboard.js L41-60.

The 'gx-cta' class is defined only in pages/Marketing/marketing.css, a lazy chunk. On a direct /login load the primary button has no background (transparent, Slate text) and looks like plain text instead of a brand CTA.
The dark toggle sets html[data-theme=dark], but the Master Admin console stays fully light. This may be intentional; please confirm.

critical_code_review_comments: index.css L782 '[data-theme=light] .text-white' is a broad override. Every inline-styled dark surface must opt in via .on-dark or it silently turns dark-on-dark. That is the root cause of the Team Performance bug.
The shadcn HSL vars are defined at :root and [data-theme=dark] only. Nested data-theme=light wrappers inherit the dark vars from html, so bg-card turns dark while text stays light-theme.
The tailwind.config.js remap doesn't catch inline hex, CSS vars or JS colour maps (#5B5BF5, #007AFF, #2563EB rgb tokens, #14181F, the CRMTerritoryMap palette).
